stepNotes.1: Single-file unit, 247 LOC; two top-level exports (RiskView namespace at risk.ts:7, RiskCommand at risk.ts:194). RiskView.lines is exercised directly by test/cli/risk-view.test.ts, justifying the namespace export.
stepNotes.2: Read-only command: process.cwd() anchor at risk.ts:228, stdout-only writes at risk.ts:239,243. No shell/fs/net. SessionRisk.load throws NotFoundError via Session.get (session/risk.ts:123) and the handler does not catch it. SessionID.make at branded.ts:19-21 is a pure brand cast with zero runtime validation.
stepNotes.3: Pure renderer. Non-null assertion at risk.ts:123 is guarded by the length check at risk.ts:119. Rollup fallback at risk.ts:58 covered by risk-view.test.ts:170-212. replaceAll('_', ' ') contract pinned by risk-view.test.ts:167 and 317-376.
stepNotes.4: Handler at risk.ts:226-246 is linear; four inclusion flags map 1:1 to SessionRisk.load options. Findings/envelopes are deliberately not loaded because the renderer never reads detail.findings or detail.envelopes.
stepNotes.5: Renderer is linear in hint count with evidence capped at 3 (risk.ts:143-147). SessionRisk.load already parallelizes via Promise.all in session/risk.ts. No N+1, no unbounded growth surface in this file.
stepNotes.6: CLI -> session -> storage dependency direction only; no circular edges. Inline NonNullable<...> aliases at risk.ts:8-11 bind to the canonical SessionRisk.Detail schema (session/risk.ts:48-65), preserving a single source of truth.
stepNotes.7: No empty catches, no TODOs, no dead helpers (validation, qualityLine, decisionHintReadiness, reviewDecisionLabel, reviewResultLine, debugCasesLine all have live call sites). Only smell is the repeated '-' divider literal, cosmetic.
stepNotes.8: One MEDIUM: missing friendly NotFoundError handling vs sibling commands rollback.ts:33 / branch.ts:22 / compare.ts:32-33 which all use getRequiredSession. Two LOW/INFO: SessionID.make does not validate; boolean flag UX and JSON shape variance. No Critical.
stepNotes.9: Verification path: pnpm --dir packages/ax-code run typecheck and pnpm --dir packages/ax-code exec vitest run test/cli/risk-view.test.ts (7 scenarios). No Critical findings, so no reverify.md required by the protocol gate.
